_comment: TRACKS PAGE COPY (English). REAL CONTENT (2026): the three tracks, their descriptions, and their example application areas are taken directly from the board-approved resolution for 'Taqathon 2' (board minutes dated 2026-07-21, section 'Third: Scientific Scope and Main Hackathon Tracks') and confirmed again in the association's own 2026 presentation deck ('Targeted Audience' slide). Nothing here is invented — see PROGRESS.md for the full source note.

hero.heading: Competition Tracks
hero.intro: Taqathon 2's three official tracks, approved by the Association's board. See the Registration page to register as a researcher, entrepreneur, or judge.

tracks.name: AI & Renewable Energy
tracks.description: Applying artificial intelligence to energy management and efficiency, and building practical renewable-energy solutions. Example areas: energy optimization, storage management, load forecasting, solar and hybrid systems, and machine learning.

tracks.name: Smart Grids & Energy Efficiency
tracks.description: Reducing consumption and improving efficiency through grid solutions and digital load management. Example areas: smart meters, load management, and peak-time control (peak shaving).

tracks.name: Hajj & Umrah
tracks.description: Innovating sustainable technologies to serve pilgrims and improve energy efficiency at the holy sites. Example areas: crowd-sustainability solutions, pedestrian cooling, and smart tents.
